title: Dbank
tagline: It is a decentralised banking application  where users can deposit and withdraw funds, transfer funds to others and also grant access to users for withdrawing or depositing funds.
description: It is a decentralised banking application where users can deposit and withdraw funds, transfer funds to others and also grant access to users for withdrawing or depositing funds. Its main aim is to have transparency and allow everyone to check what is really happening and no information is hidden from the users.
how_its_made: I used solidity for building the smart contract where users can deposit and withdraw funds, transfer funds to others and also grant access to users for withdrawing or depositing funds. Its main aim is to have transparency and allow everyone to check what is really happening and no information is hidden from the users.
